relationships.subject: long ciliary nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: upregulated mRNA levels of ion channels Piezo2, TRPM8, and TRPV1, as well as inflammatory factors TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, were also detected in the TG after LCN ligation

relationships.subject: long ciliary nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: we observed that LCN ligation increased calcitonin gene-related peptide (neuropeptide)-positive cells in the trigeminal ganglion (TG)

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: consecutive oral gabapentin attenuated LCN ligation-induced corneal hyperalgesia and increased levels of ion channels and inflammation factors in TG

key_findings: Long ciliary nerve ligation in rats produces corneal hypersensitivity, nerve loss and photophobia reversed by morphine or gabapentin.
LCN ligation increases CGRP-positive TG cells and TRPV1, TRPM8, Piezo2, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6 mRNA in the trigeminal ganglion, attenuated by gabapentin.
